items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that every separation axiom listed in the chapter's definition of a separated morphism of formal algebraic spaces is stable under base change (statement lines 6820-6824). The proof names the objects, observes that the diagonal of the base change is the base change of the diagonal along X' x_{Y'} X' -> X x_Y X, and records that each of the diagonal properties occurring in the definition is stable under base change, which proves the claim (proof lines 6827-6833). The level is H2 rather than H1: the argument is complete and displayed, but its real content is the identification of the diagonal of the base change, and the verification that each individual property on the list is base-change stable is delegated to the properties of morphisms it is read off from.
